# jumpcloud_ip_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud IP list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_ip_list" "office" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the IP list.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the IP list.
- `ips` (List of String) List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges.
- `name` (String) The name of the IP list.
